newsitem.title: USA: VIMRx in Columbia University collaboration.
newsitem.headline: VIMRx in Columbia University collaboration.

text.p: VIMRx Pharmaceuticals Inc and Columbia University Monday said they entered a collaboration whereby VIMRx, through a new subsidiary VIMRx Genomics Inc, will have an option for exclusive licensing of technology developed by the Columbia Genome Center and funded by VIMRx.

The company said collaboration will involve technology for the localization and identification of novel human genes associated with genetically based diseases. The investigators at the Columbia Genone Center has been working on identifying specific genes associated with genetically based diseases including cancer, late-onset Alzheimer's Disease, epilepsy, manic-depressive disorder and glaucoma.
